summary.text: Janne Myrdal is a Republican state senator from District 19 in Edinburg who has represented the district since December 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a farmer and homemaker who chairs the interim Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Janne Myrdal's legislative biography lists her occupations as homemaker and farmer.
She has been affiliated with the ND Rural Development Council, the board of ND DE Social Services, and Concerned Women for America, according to Ballotpedia.
Her legislative biography also lists membership in the ALEC rural caucus and the chair of the North Dakota Legislative Pro Life Caucus, and says she is married with three children.
Ballotpedia lists Myrdal as winning North Dakota Senate District 10 elections in 2016 and 2020, and a District 19 election in 2022.
Her 2025 assignments include the Judiciary Committee and the Agriculture and Veterans Affairs Committee, where she is vice chair, and she chairs the interim Judiciary Committee.
